Sandbox_VehicleEvents_FuelLowPercent_too: Fuel below this fires FuelLow. FuelNoLongerLow fires once it is 5%% above again.
Sandbox_VehicleEvents_BatteryLowPercent_: Battery charge below this fires BatteryLow. BatteryNoLongerLow fires once it is 5%% above again.
Sandbox_VehicleEvents_FlippedAngle_toolt: A car tilted more than this from upright fires Flipped (90 = on its side, 180 = on its roof). BackOnWheels fires once it is back under this angle minus 25.
Sandbox_VehicleEvents_WorldCheckMs_toolt: Time between two checks of every loaded car, for the world events. Lower = faster events, more work for the server.
Sandbox_VehicleEvents_WorldCarsPerTick_t: How many cars a world check handles per game tick. Lower = smoother on servers with many cars, but a full check takes longer.
